the use of CT Colonography (CTC) to detect and characterize polyps is feasible, but the sensitivity for detection of small polyps is low.

volumetric textural analysis of colorectal masses at computed tomographic (CT) colonography (CTC) can differentiate benign versus malignant pathology and can be performed with a high degree of accuracy, and is comparable to human reader performance.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we have developed a new method to automatically detect colorectal masses in computed tomography colonography (CTC) images.

volumetric textural analysis (TA) of CT colonography (CTC) images is feasible, and that TA may have potential as a tool for improving CTC diagnostic accuracy, especially when used in conjunction with human readers.
